task:
A levy charges 16% on the first 3000 credits of a 7953-credit bill and 45% on the remainder. Subtract a 8-credit rebate from the levy (floor at zero), then apply a 7% surcharge to that reduced levy. What is the exact final levy? No rounding. After computing that result, apply these further settlement adjustments IN ORDER, with no rounding:
Adjustment 1: add 16 credits, then discount the whole amount by 18%.
Adjustment 2: apply a 18% surcharge, then subtract 20 credits.
Adjustment 3: add 20 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Adjustment 4: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 5 credits.
Adjustment 5: add 20 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 6: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 10 credits.
Adjustment 7: add 18 credits, then discount the whole amount by 4%.
Adjustment 8: apply a 19% surcharge, then subtract 13 credits.
Adjustment 9: add 6 credits, then discount the whole amount by 3%.
Adjustment 10: apply a 17% surcharge, then subtract 27 credits.
Adjustment 11: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 11%.
Adjustment 12: apply a 13% surcharge, then subtract 19 credits.
Adjustment 13: add 11 credits, then discount the whole amount by 8%.
Adjustment 14: apply a 5% surcharge, then subtract 11 credits.
Adjustment 15: add 25 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Adjustment 16: apply a 15% surcharge, then subtract 25 credits.
Adjustment 17: add 22 credits, then discount the whole amount by 6%.
Adjustment 18: apply a 16% surcharge, then subtract 23 credits.
Adjustment 19: add 21 credits, then discount the whole amount by 14%.
Show intermediate steps, with one line for each follow-on stage in the form Amount after adjustment <n>: <exact value>. End with Final answer: <reduced fraction, or integer if its denominator is one>.
